$comment: Worked vectors of the contributor page's previewSha256 (design PROFILE-PAGE-2026-10-06 §3.6; the definition is in schemas/contributor-page.v1.json): the document, the preimage (generatedAt and versionId removed, card.h16 removed, a GitHub picture reduced to {"kind":"github"}), its RFC 8785 (JCS) text, and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that text's UTF-8 bytes.

The api and index-build (C#, through the one builder) and any reader recompute every vector. check:contributor-page validates each document against contributor-page.v1 and recomputes the preimage, the text and the digest. A C# serialiser that escapes non-ASCII by default (System.Text.Json does) fails PV-3, which is why it is here.

1.3.0 (ops decision D165): the one builder writes `cards`, the cards' three choices resolved, on every document, so PV-1 to PV-5 carry the defaults right before `sections` and were recomputed with it (their documents are the builder's); PV-6 is examples/contributor-page.v1.cards.example.json, the GitHub mark on every card and every repository named alone.

1.4.0 (ops decision D168 item 3): adopter items gain `since` and `until` (years). Both are optional and written only where the builder knows them, so PV-1 to PV-6 keep their bytes and their hashes (their facts carry no evidence date); PV-7 is examples/contributor-page.v1.adopter-years.example.json, with a dated item, a repository that left and an undated item.

1.5.0 (ops decision D165 item 3, the organisation's picture): `autoUpdated` gains `organisation-pictures`, which the one builder writes from the settings alone (the cards' icon `owner`, and the projects section, or the adopter section with the login shown, switched on), so PV-1, PV-3 and PV-5 carry it and were recomputed with it (their documents are the builder's); PV-2, PV-4, PV-6 and PV-7 keep their bytes. The `picture` of a repository group and of an adopter item (an organisation's copy) leaves the preimage, step (4): PV-8 is examples/contributor-page.v1.organisation-pictures.example.json, an organisation's copy named on its group and on its adopter item, a person's group and the page owner's own beside it.

1.6.0 (a certificate's period by its months; the orchestrator's answer of 2026-10-21T20:26Z): a certificate item gains `months`, `{from, to}`, the months of its record's `period.validFrom` and `period.validUntil`, which the one builder writes on every item, so PV-1, PV-2 and PV-4 to PV-6 carry it right after `years` and were recomputed with it (their documents are the builder's): the year's certificate (`2026-01` to `2026-12`) in PV-1, PV-5 and PV-6, a month's in PV-2 (`2026-09`) and PV-6 (`2027-01`), and part of a year in PV-4 (`2026-02` to `2026-03`). PV-3, PV-7 and PV-8 list no certificate and keep their bytes.

1.8.0 (ops decision D186 items 1 and 2): `listings`, the view each kind of list opens in and whether visitors get the toggle, which the one builder writes only where an owner's choice differs from its default, so PV-1 to PV-8 keep their bytes and their hashes; PV-9 is examples/contributor-page.v1.listings.example.json, the cards page with the certificates as a list and the repositories as a matrix that visitors may switch.

vectors.note: The named page of examples/contributor-page.v1.example.json: `generatedAt`, `versionId` and `card.h16` leave the preimage; the uploaded picture keeps its `h16`, so the publish is pinned to the file the person previewed.

vectors.note: The cards page of examples/contributor-page.v1.cards.example.json (1.3.0): `cards` names the GitHub mark and every repository by its name alone, as the settings store `{icon: github, otherNames: name}` with `ownNames` left out at its default and the builder writes all three; a GitHub picture with its copy is reduced to `{"kind":"github"}`, as in PV-3.

The licence adopter's years (1.4.0; ops decision D168 item 3), the page of examples/contributor-page.v1.adopter-years.example.json: an item whose evidence date is stored carries `since` ("Since 2026"), a repository that quit carries `since` and `until` ("2026–2027"), and an item stored before its date was carries neither; each is inside the preimage like every member, so a year that appears or a repository that leaves is a new preview, which `autoUpdated`'s `adopter` lets a published page take without one. A GitHub picture whose copy does not exist yet is reduced to {"kind":"github"}, as in PV-2.

An organisation's picture (1.5.0; ops decision D165 item 3), the page of examples/contributor-page.v1.organisation-pictures.example.json: `example-org`'s group and its licence adopter item each name the organisation's copy `o-9b2e4c6a8d0f1e3a-96.png` (`$defs.organisationPicture`), and both leave the preimage (step (4)), as the private preview names none: the api copies nothing, and the published page gains the copy when it exists, under `autoUpdated`'s `organisation-pictures`. `sam-codes`, a person, and the page owner's own `example-contributor` carry none. A GitHub picture whose copy exists is reduced to {"kind":"github"}, its letters with it, as in PV-3.

The listings page of examples/contributor-page.v1.listings.example.json (1.8.0; ops decision D186): `listings` carries only what differs from the defaults, the certificates' view `list` and the repositories' view `matrix` with the visitors' toggle, as the settings store it and the builder writes it; it is inside the preimage like every member, so a view or a toggle changed after the preview answers `page.preview_changed`.
